newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures firm in line with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures firm in line with NYMEX.

text.p: September Brent futures were slightly firmer in late trading on SIMEX on Monday, keeping track of a firmer tone on NYMEX.
Crudes were supported by sentiment surrounding gasoline, which drove both sides of the Atlantic higher on Friday.
September Brent crude on SIMEX was last traded at $18.60 per barrel, up seven cents from London. A small 40 lots had traded by 0820 GMT.
NYMEX September crude was last traded at $19.98 per barrel -- the intraday high and extending New York's 12-cent rally by a further nine cents.
Brokers said gasoline remained the main factor supporting the crude complex.

A tight reformulated gasoline and MTBE market was driving NYMEX futures higher. August gasoline in New York gained 1.82 cents per gallon to 64.03 cents per gallon and was last traded in light ACCESS traded at 64.20, for an additional rise of 0.17 cent.
